newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL NOON RUBBER MIXED ON THIN VOLUME.
newsitem.headline: KL NOON RUBBER MIXED ON THIN VOLUME.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were mixed at midday, with sellers making adjustments to their quotes after tracking a soft ringgit, traders said.
The trend was also reflective of the mixed futures market in Tokyo, they said.
"What do you do in a market without buyers? Play around with prices, of course," said a trader.
At the close, the RSS1 for September buyer was officially quoted at 247.50 cents (94 U.S. cents) a kg, unchanged from Thursday's close.
The SMR20 for September buyer closed at 246.00, down half cent from Thursday.
Trading houses retained Thursday's price levels, offering the SMR 20 at 243 cents a kg, the SMR CV at 289 cents, SMR L at 271, SMR 5 at 253, SMR 10 at 245 and drum latex at 189.
Malaysia-based shipping brokers quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $700 per 20-ft container, and $1,400 per 40-ft container.
